text: dsh-clawo 是一款 DSH 插件包，通过补丁把 DeepSeek Harness 自带的 ACP 子代理客户端配置为 Claw Orchestrator 提供方，并以 clawo 名称注册。它使用 npx 启动 Claw Orchestrator 的 ACP 命令，让 DSH 子代理请求交给主机上已认证的编码 CLI 运行；README 介绍了单引擎回答、多引擎 council、长程规划和并行审查等模式。适合希望在 DSH 中委派编码任务、组织多引擎协作的开发者。安装需要支持 bundle patch 的 DSH 和 Node.js，且主机需配置要调用的编码 CLI。

dsh-clawo registers Claw Orchestrator as a DSH ACP subagent provider. Its patch launches the orchestrator through npx to handle delegated work with host coding CLIs. The README describes single-engine, council, planning, and parallel review modes. It requires Node.js, compatible DSH, and CLIs.
想让 DSH 把编码任务交给另一种代理处理。
如何在 DSH 里接入 ACP 子代理提供方？
我希望多个编码引擎一起讨论并给出综合方案。
让 DSH 调用主机上已经登录的编码 CLI。
想并行安排多个代理检查当前工作区。
能否在 DSH 中使用长程规划模式处理复杂任务？
Delegate a coding task from DSH to an ACP subagent.
Have several coding agents debate a change and synthesize a result.
Run parallel reviewers against my working tree from DSH.
dsh-clawo 的功能「ACP 子代理注册」：补丁在 DSH 配置中插入 clawo 提供方，并指定 ACP 客户端启动 Claw Orchestrator。
dsh-clawo 的功能「委派给编码引擎」：通过 npx 启动 ACP 命令，将子代理工作交给主机上配置的编码 CLI。
dsh-clawo 的功能「多引擎协作模式」：README 描述 council 模式可让多个引擎在隔离 worktree 中讨论并综合结果，通过提示中的斜杠命令选择模式。
dsh-clawo 的功能「规划与并行审查」：README 还列出 ultraplan 长程规划和 ultrareview 并行审查工作区的模式。

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · @enderfga/dsh-clawo：`dsh` already ships `subagent-claude-code` and `subagent-codex`, so delegating to a single
coding CLI is covered. This delegates to something none of those can be: a **multi-engine
runtime**. A `clawo` subagent can answer with one engine, or convene a council of several in
isolated git worktrees and hand back the synthesis.

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @enderfga/dsh-clawo
```

That is the whole setup. The bundle contains no code — it is nine lines of YAML that point
dsh's own ACP client at `npx @enderfga/claw-orchestrator acp`.

Verify it composed into your profile:

```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep -A6 subagent-clawo
```

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · What the subagent can do：The provider is registered as `clawo`. Its prompts run through
[Claw Orchestrator's ACP agent](https://github.com/Enderfga/claw-orchestrator/blob/main/skills/references/acp.md),
which supports:

| Mode | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `single` (default) | One engine answers. |
| `council` | Several engines debate in isolated git worktrees and reach consensus. |
| `ultraplan` | Long-horizon planning pass. |
| `ultrareview` | Parallel reviewers sweep the working tree. |
@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · What the subagent can do：Modes are selected with a slash command in the prompt — `/council fix the failing test`.

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · Requirements：- `dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 or newer (the `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest contract and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp`).
- Node 22.19+ / 24+, matching dsh's own floor.
- Whichever coding CLIs you want Claw Orchestrator to drive, authenticated on the host —
  `claude`, `codex`, and so on. The subagent runs on your machine, not in dsh.

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · Known limitations：- **No conversation resume.** `loadSession` is advertised as `false`. This suits dsh, whose ACP
  subagent provider starts a fresh session per run and inherits no parent context anyway.
- **No mid-turn permission prompt.** Claw Orchestrator resolves permission into engine CLI flags
  when a session opens, so `session/request_permission` is not implemented. dsh's provider
  defaults to auto-rejecting permission requests, so nothing is lost here.
- **Council is slow.** A measured two-round run took roughly nine minutes. It is a deliberate
  action, not a default.

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · Why `npx` and not a dependency：Claw Orchestrator depends on `re2`, a 17 MB native module used for ReDoS-safe pattern matching.
Declaring it as a dependency would make every dsh profile compile a native addon at install
time. Fetching the published binary through `npx` keeps this bundle at three files and zero
dependencies, and keeps a failed native build out of your profile install.

@enderfga/dsh-clawo README · Status：`dsh` is in developer preview and states that compatibility-breaking changes are expected. This
bundle depends on exactly two things — the `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest contract and the config
keys of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` — so a break here is a YAML fix, not a rewrite. Please
open an issue if a dsh release moves either.
